description: Hackathon: Flip-the-Switch. Public submission repo for the Flip the Switch Hackathon: a council room workflow on Switch, hosted on nexus, reusable for Buddy Town.
Demo app for Flip the Switch hackathon
IncidentRoom — on-call incident closeout in Switch chat (Flip the Switch Track 01)
CASCADE — deterministic commitment recovery engine for Flip the Switch 2026
knixx thunder — flip a switch, sense the room, speak knx
AgentQA Network — multi-user QA collaboration platform with Switch agent integration (Flip the Switch Hackathon).
AI-powered PR reviews in Discord, powered by Switch + Antigravity. Built for the Flip the Switch Hackathon.
CrewPilot — Evidence-Driven Bug Investigation Squad. Track: Flip the Switch Hackathon
RelayOS — Autonomous Enterprise Deal Closing Platform (Flip the Switch Hackathon Track 01)
ClearSend Room: Switch-connected agent workflow for flights and escrow in Slack/Discord (Flip the Switch hackathon)
Chat-native ops room: Switch agents behind a role-based, approval-gated Gatekeeper (Flip the Switch hackathon)
The Flip the Switch Hackathon project for Slack integrated ai automation for insurance docs
Autonomous DeFi & smart contract security copilot for Discord & team chat, powered by Switch. Built for the WeMakeDevs Flip the Switch Hackathon.
FMCG distributor order desk in team chat: Telegram + Mattermost + one AI agent via Switch. Flip the Switch hackathon 2026.
Reservation requests from several sources, one Switch room, a person decides. Flip the Switch Hackathon entry; synthetic fixtures only.
Self-healing team knowledge base: Switch-connected agents turn chat corrections into owner-approved git changes (Flip the Switch hackathon)
DeskPilot: an AI support-triage teammate that drafts and a human approves, in team chat via Switch (Flip the Switch hackathon)
Public kill-switch state for Vortex local runs. Polls here; only the owner flips it.
Fictional product roadmap for the Splitbrain demo (Flip the Switch hackathon). Acme and all people are fictional.
Flip the Switch hackathon: keep customer commitments aligned with approved scope, verified delivery, and follow-up.
Evidence-first invoice review in real Switch rooms. AI explains exceptions; a named reviewer approves an exact evidence digest. Flip the Switch 2026.
Telegram back office where a shop owner and three AI agents run orders, stock, shipping and refunds together via Switch (Flip the Switch hackathon)
Preflight: a Switch room that takes a project from 'we think we're done' to 'verified, ready to submit'. The model proposes, code decides. Flip the Switch hackathon.
A Switch room where a person and three AI agents (Scout, Rules Checker, Builder) run a hackathon/bounty pipeline together. Flip the Switch 2026, Personal/Creative track.
An agent in your team chat that answers 'why don't we do X?' with the source. Flip the Switch, Track 01.
Six Arcade-style games in one cabinet. Includes regular modes and flipped modes, where you and the CPU switch places.
Darkline Producer — a Switch workflow that turns a one-line horror seed into a production-ready daily short, with human approval gates. Flip the Switch hackathon, Track 02.
A solo traveller's AI crew in one Telegram group: Planner, Budget and Reel Adder agents on Switch, with a live pixel-art view. WeMakeDevs Flip the Switch hackathon.

Digest Room — Flip the Switch (Best Business Workflow): a Switch room where an agent posts the morning digest, teammates claim work with a ✅ reaction, and the day closes with a summary. Stdlib Python only.
Flip the Switch hackathon (Track 02): a Switch agent that posts a scheduled morning briefing (crypto prices, deadline countdowns, tech news) and answers follow-up Q&A in-room with running memory.
Snapchat-style camera flip for the iOS 6 Camera app: double-tap the preview to switch cameras, for photos and videos. Even mid-recording, without stopping: one continuous video.

A cat races through four increasingly challenging levels, jumping over hazards and collecting fish. Along the way, it flips gravity, freezes moving saws, and switches between dimensions to reach the finish.

From a customer’s text to a deployed fix in minutes. A Switch workflow where AI agents and humans close the loop across Telegram and Slack: reproduce, fix, review, approve, ship and reply, with human sign-off on every risky step. Built for the Flip the Switch hackathon.

WinCrow is a power-tool that strips Windows 10 and Windows 11 down to what you actually use. It removes bloated apps, lets you choose what starts with Windows, and flips 43 privacy, performance and interface switches. Every change can be undone from the same window.
Call a vet clinic front desk in your browser, then flip the switches that break voice agents: barge-in, keyterms, end of turn. Deepgram Voice Agent API with Flux and Flux TTS.

A living Nishikigoi sanctuary: orbit and zoom around a waterfall and lotus garden while 22 koi cruise the pond. Feed them or tap the water to toss pellets, switch camera views and flip to golden hour.

Argo CD ApplicationSet matrix generators across dev/stage/prod/prod-dr EKS clusters, with single-switch DR failover and a Go CLI (drswitch) that health-checks the target, flips the GitOps flag and shifts Route53 weights.

A little ESP32 and servo that flips my light switch from anywhere. I tap Light ON or Light OFF on a web page hosted free on Cloudflare, the ESP32 checks for new commands every few seconds, and the servo swings its arm to push a normal wall switch. No rewiring, no ports to open, nothing touched inside the wall. Began as a PC power button presser.

Powered by an Arduino microcontroller and a KY-038 acoustic sensor, this device enables elderly and mobility-impaired individuals to turn on lights hands-free at night. The sensor was physically calibrated to filter out background noise to respond only to a blow, which activates a servo motor to flip the light switch.

T3 Code style agent threads for Herdr, built on Herdr's own spaces. Working agents keep going in the background while the ones that need you rise to the top. Save spaces as projects, search and hop between them, and flip to any agent with a quick switcher. Prefix key bindings for anyone who loved the herdr TUI or tmux.

WhyNotWin11 reads this PC and lists whether it meets the checks Windows 11 is known for: CPU, TPM, Secure Boot, RAM, and similar items. It reports. It does not flip those switches for you, and it does not install Windows. A red line is a fact about this machine, not a puzzle you solve by disabling security.

Run supported Nintendo Switch games natively on Mac, iPhone & iPad. One-command setup, complete Mac apps, lightweight iOS builds, Xbox/PS4/PS5 controllers and editable touch controls. Built on seedds/nxnative. Bring your own games and keys.
Black Ops II (Xbox 360) on Nintendo Switch and Windows by static recompilation: Zombies, Multiplayer and Campaign, built from your own game files
Native Nintendo Switch (libnx) and PC host for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, built on the-browsing-of-isaac's static recompilation. Bring your own copy of the game.
Nintendo Switch port of Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks, built on OAleex's ShaolinMonksRecomp (Xbox static recompilation), Vulkan via NVK
Native Windows port of Pokémon Sword / Shield (Switch, 1.3.2) by static recompilation, built on Let's Go Recomp and LAS Recomp. No game files included.
Test Drive II (1989) as a native Windows game: EGA, CGA, Hercules and Amiga graphics switchable live, built on the Kylofon SDL3 port
Dark Souls Remastered running natively on Apple silicon Macs, built from your own Switch dump (60-120 fps, up to 4K). No game data included.
NX Pocket: one iPhone app for your own Switch games. Game packs, NX Pocket for Mac, foldable-phone layouts and local play over Wi-Fi. Built on nxnative. Not affiliated with Nintendo.
A Switch 2 homebrew SDK built on HBLauncher by RavensClawX.
⌃Tab window switcher for macOS built on yabai, with ScreenCaptureKit thumbnails
Fire drills for teams of people and agents, built on Switch
A light-DOM tri-state theme picker built on <form-multi-switch>.
Menu bar kill switch for WireGuard on macOS, built on pf, with live leak checking.
Unbound plugin that unlocks Discord's built-in multi-account switcher on iOS
Switch Blade: free 4-synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (OB-Z, WAVE, NANO, JUNO). Built on Felucca. GPL-3.0.
Let agents read the outside world without handing them the keys. Built on Switch.
Run Pokémon Reloaded on Nintendo Switch (native runtime based on OpenGMK). Hobby project built with AI help.
Your team writes the rules in chat. Canary tries to break them on every PR. Built on Switch.
A video player frontend for OnionOS built to feel like switching channels on a cablebox.
Mac Globe key not switching language on first press? GlobeToggle switches macOS keyboard layouts with a short Fn/Globe tap. Built with Swift.
Alt Hop: one-click account switcher for the Riot Client, Valorant and League on Windows. Session-file swap, no stored passwords. Built with Tauri 2.
Show what you play on Nintendo Switch 1 and 2 as Discord Rich Presence. Windows tray app built on nxapi.
Claude Code add-on for Home Assistant with ha-mcp built in and a read-only switch
The most-used business charts with a 2D/3D switch, built on Apache ECharts 6 and ECharts GL.
Switch your Linux cursor theme with one short command, with a terminal UI preview. Built for Hyprland on Arch.
Clean any Android TV on the TV itself: asks what you use, switches off the rest, re-applies after every boot. Built on CleanYourTV.
Plays the Nintendo Switch release of Well Dweller natively on an Apple Silicon Mac (no emulator, no game data in this repository). Built on nxnative.
Friends write the mystery, a director twists it live, and a checker proves the players can still finish. Built on Switch.

Built an AWS blue-green deployment pipeline using Terraform, ECS Fargate, ECR, and GitHub Actions. Automates container builds, deploys releases to an inactive environment, validates them with smoke tests, and switches live traffic through an Application Load Balancer, with rollback workflows and CloudWatch monitoring for safer deployments.
RetroForge's Switch player for Android: a companion for RetroForge, built on Eden (GPL-3.0). No keys, firmware or games included.
A self-hosted Pokémon trade bot for your own Switch, with a web page instead of Discord commands. Built on SysBot.NET.
macOS menu-bar app: tap Caps Lock to switch input sources instantly, with a correct language indicator. Built on CapsLangSwitcher by Gamezxz.
Small tool-using support agent with sandboxed tools and a guards on/off switch, built as a target for agent security evaluation
Background FTP server sysmodule for the Nintendo Switch, built on ITotalJustice's ftpsrv, with an Ultrahand overlay to start, stop and configure it.
Moonmap: a desktop map app laid out like Apple Maps, built on Moonframe. Switchable tile providers, place sheets, directions and 360° Look Around.
🎧 On-the-go floating desktop audio output & microphone input switcher built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, and Rust (Windows Core Audio API)

Native port of Octopath Traveler II (Switch) to macOS and iOS, built on nxnative's HLE host with a classic Metal (macOS 15+ / iOS 18+) graphics backend. Bring your own legally dumped game and keys; no game files included. 八方旅人 II, 原生运行在 Mac/IOS上
Native Windows port of Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! (Switch v1.0.0) by static recompilation, built on LAS Recomp. No game files included.
Shield: a human-in-the-loop data quality agent for team chat, built on Switch (business-date gate, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata adapter, local Gemma)
A WebGPU raymarched jelly toggle switch, built with TypeGPU. Click or tap it and the jelly slides, squashes and wobbles between off and on.
Native Apple ports from your own Switch library: Xcode signing, system resources, Joy-Con controls, LAN/LDN discovery and experimental Nextendo integration. Built on nxnative.
A security crew of four AI agents that lives in your team chat and stops bad npm/PyPI packages before anyone installs them. Built on Switch.
Native Nintendo Switch homebrew port of Touhou 12: Undefined Fantastic Object (東方星蓮船), built on Tweet-META's C++ reimplementation. No game files included.
A  personal portfolio and blog built on an Astro theme, then reshaped with a custom colour scheme, a real dark mode switch, and content written from scratch.
Click the back of a desktop inside KDE Plasma's Desktop Cube to switch to it. No sudo. Built on ARM64 Linux Fedora 44 Asahi KDE Plasma.
A custom Discord client for Android, Windows & Mac. Custom badges, platform indicators and 89+ built-in plugins, just switch them on. No setup, just download and install.
Hands-on Cisco Packet Tracer labs covering network fundamentals, switching, routing, IP services, network security, and automation. Built as part of my practical networking and CCNA learning journey.
AI outage triage for utilities without smart meters: turns multilingual complaints, crew reports and photos into located faults, safe switching and crew dispatch. Built on Meta's Muse models.

3 in 1: Incredible monitor zoning, windows switcher and windows placer as well as caffeinate function. Always on menu-bar app ⌘⇥ window switcher with optional previews, device monitoring, windows framing, set-saving app by app. Keep-awake timer. Native Swift, no dependencies, built from source.
AI incident response squad in your team chat: triage, fixer and reviewer agents take a bug from report to merged PR, with a human approving in Discord. Built on Switch.
A plain-language checklist of ten things to check before launching an app built on Supabase, plus a read-only SQL query that finds tables with row level security switched off.
A failure lab on one Linux host or VM: a small service and a worker that you can switch into six bad behaviors, and a runbook built from what you saw.
Per-session switch for DeepSeek Harness that hides the built-in web_search tool from the model. Off: the tool leaves that session's schema. On: it returns without a restart.

A beginner-friendly Java project that allows users to select their daily mood and receive a positive message based on their feelings. Built using Scanner, switch statements, and basic conditional logic.
Unattended farm help-desk ticket agent (safety floor, audit log, kill switch) on a Vultr VM. Vultr Agent Rush entry. Built by Tab, an AI assistant, for team lead Akshay Wagh. MIT.

Switching GPU modes on an NVIDIA Optimus laptop usually means logging in, running commands, and rebooting by hand. Optimus Boot lets you pick a mode from a simple text menu at boot, before the login screen, and applies the change and restarts for you, saving you a login just to switch. Built on top of EnvyControl.
Q&A chatbot built with LangChain that runs on OpenAI or a local Ollama model, with a Streamlit app to switch between them and a comparison of quality, latency, cost and privacy.

Reconfigured the built-in Kubernetes scheduler for GPU workloads using only declarative KubeSchedulerConfiguration: switched NodeResourcesFit scoring to MostAllocated weighted on nvidia.com/gpu, and removed default topology spreading that conflicted with packing.

From a customer’s text to a deployed fix in minutes. A Switch workflow where AI agents and humans close the loop across Telegram and Slack: reproduce, fix, review, approve, ship and reply, with human sign-off on every risky step. Built for the Flip the Switch hackathon.
Unlocks the hidden DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution and FSR 3 upscalers built into EA SPORTS FC 27 on PC. Switch modes in game with hotkeys. Requires the FC Live Editor (offline only).

Database-backed translation manager for Filament 5: edit, search, scan and quick-translate every __() string per locale, with a topbar language switcher. Successor of kenepa/translation-manager, built on spatie/laravel-translation-loader.

A small ISO 8583 switching prototype built with Java, Spring Boot, and jPOS. Implements client-server messaging, transaction request validation, basic authorization responses, and socket timeout handling as a hands-on learning project.

Modern replacement for the XAMPP Control Panel on Windows: clean MySQL/MariaDB shutdown, PHP and MariaDB version switching, local HTTPS sites (virtual hosts), php.ini editor, dark mode. Built with .NET 10 and Avalonia.

Hands-on networking labs in Cisco Packet Tracer, built as a foundation for a SOC Analyst career. Covers routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, NAT, port security, and logging, with configs, topology diagrams, and verification steps.

Invigilator-controlled quiz platform with LLM-assisted question generation, email allow-listing, one-time access, tab-switch logging, and timed assessments. Built with Next.js, Supabase (PostgreSQL), and Tailwind CSS. Deployed free on Vercel.

# Birthday Card for Fatimah 🎂  An interactive, single-file birthday card website, built as a surprise gift.  ## What happens 1. The site opens in darkness and asks the visitor to switch on the lights. 2. A bedroom appears, and the visitor goes out through the door into a scary hallway. 3. They go back inside, switch the light on again,

Open-hardware keyboard/mouse switch for two computers, built on RP2040. Switch with Win+F12 or by moving the mouse past the screen edge. Works in BIOS, no host software. One USB-A port for any keyboard or dongle, microSD shared drive. KiCad boards (RP2040-Zero or bare RP2040) + 3D-printable OpenSCAD case.

A tiny live cryptocurrency price ticker for the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 and the XIAO Expansion Board. Prices show up on the built-in OLED screen, and you switch between coins with the on-board user button. No API key needed.

A lightweight Chrome extension that applies your cookie consent preference automatically and shows cookie storage for the current site. Built with React and custom CSS, with a compact popup and a simple on/off switch.

A user-level thread library and scheduler built in C. Switches context based on based on a round-robin schedule in which the thread that just ran is rotated till the back and threads are rotated until a ready one is found.

A code agent built on LangChain Deep Agents + LangGraph — web UI, real disk + shell, sub-agents, long-term memory, skills, MCP, per-task workspaces, runtime model switching, human-in-the-loop approvals. A learning project.

A drop-in sqlite3.dll with everything switched on: FTS5, R*Tree, Geopoly, math functions, DBSTAT, sessions, plus the vec0 vector extension — built from pinned, hash-verified sources. DLL #4 in the Windows DLL Collection

A Claude skill for B2B customer interviews: plan, run, score and synthesize switch, win-loss and churn interviews that turn into marketing decisions. Built on Forget the Funnel, Teresa Torres, The Mom Test and Clozd.
Control your Mac with your hand: point to move the cursor, pinch to click, wave to switch apps. Runs on the built-in camera, fully local, written in Rust. Companion code for a beginner Rust tutorial.

Dead man's switch for dreamDEX perps.  You stop checking in, Subsidium warns you, cuts your positions in steps, then closes everything.   Built on Somnia Reactivity with an optional margin health guard and an on-chain black box timeline. Solidity (Foundry), React + viem dashboard.

A low-cost hydroponics monitor and pump controller built on the ESP32. It measures air temperature, humidity, light, water level, TDS / pH, shows the readings on an OLED screen, and hosts a WiFi dashboard with live gauges that opens on any phone or laptop on the same network. The water pump is switched ON and OFF from the dashboard through a relay.

AI-powered switch access for people with severe motor disabilities like ALS. Traditional switch scanning steps through every item on screen one press at a time. KIN Access uses Meta's Muse Spark to predict the 4 most likely next actions, so tasks take a few presses instead of dozens. Built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.

Run two to four simulated RTS clients over a fake network, switch on a source of nondeterminism, and watch the per-tick state hashes split. Compares input-delay lockstep with rollback, with autograded exercises. Built with Claude Code.

Native Code Execution engine for Nintendo Switch titles on the Orange Pi 5 Pro (RK3588 / Mali-G610). Built on Eden's Horizon OS layer; the guest's ARM64 code runs natively on the Cortex-A76 — no JIT, no interpreter. Written with AI assistance and reviewed by a human. GPL-3.0-or-later.
ㄅㄆMac ㄈ (bopo MAC fo) by MAKOTO LAB — 把 Mac 的注音輸入邏輯帶到 Windows。Open-source Windows Bopomofo IME with Mac-style candidate selection, CapsLock switching and emoji, built on McBopomofoWeb/PIME.

A web interface for monitoring and managing Cisco Nexus switches through NX-API, so everyday checks and changes don't need an SSH session.  Built and tested against a Nexus 9000 (N9K-C92160YC-X) on NX-OS 9.3.

Pure-Java 21 notification library built on SOLID principles and GoF patterns (Strategy, Factory, Builder). Features a unified multi-channel abstraction (Email, SMS, Push, Slack), multi-provider switching (SendGrid, Twilio), asynchronous CompletableFuture dispatch, custom exceptions, SLF4J logging, and JUnit 5 mocks.

The Active Multifilament System 3 Pro is a high-performance 3D printing solution integrating active/passive drying, fast filament switching, and auto-rewind. Built on open-source principles with embedded control, it prevents tangles and moisture issues for reliable printing.

A design system you choose from three options, built from your own codebase. It reads your project, proposes three design-system directions on one switchable page, and turns your choice into the approved reference that all later design work follows.

Automatically switch Windows between Light and Dark themes based on sunrise, sunset, custom schedules, and system conditions. A lightweight, privacy-focused Windows desktop app built with Rust, Tauri 2, and Svelte 5, featuring native Windows 11 Fluent Design and Mica effects.

A self-hosted, sovereign runtime for enterprise AI agents. Built on a fault-tolerant Erlang OTP Supervisor, it features zero-token state persistence, Google Zanzibar-inspired ReBAC, and a strict Step 5 Spend Kill Switch for hard financial boundaries. (Community Edition)

macOS menu bar app that turns AirPods Pro head motion into Mac controls: tilt to scroll, turn for browser back and forward, lean to switch desktops. No camera, all processing stays on the Mac. Built with Swift 6, SwiftUI and CoreMotion.

Blender addon to test & retarget Unity humanoid animations directly on your avatar. Preview animations in real-time, switch between clips, check root motion, and export ready-for-Unity files. Built for VRChat & VTuber creators to validate animations early in Blender.

SJ: an Android assistant that opens Claude, Google Play and TikTok on command, only when you switch it on. Understands Urdu, Hindi and English. Generates AI video scripts with the Claude API and sends them to your video API. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, no PC needed (GitHub Actions build).

As someone with multiple monitors myself, having the default alt-tab switch to a screen that is already open in another screen, instead of application on the local screen itself, annoys me.  So I built a better alt-tab, with it working locally on each screen by locating your mouse.

VoiceMaster: an Android assistant that opens Claude, Google Play and TikTok on command, only when you switch it on. Understands Urdu, Hindi and English. Generates AI video scripts with the Claude API and sends them to your video API. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, no PC needed (GitHub Actions build).

Home Assistant integration for cFos Power Brain wallboxes over Modbus TCP. Monitor charging, energy and phase currents; set the charging current, enable or disable charging, switch between 1 and 3 phases. Built on Home Assistant’s shared Modbus connections. Installable via HACS.

Android gallery built on independent browse sessions: create named sessions (animals, weddings...), fill each with folders chosen through Android's native folder selector, and every session remembers its last seen photo — switch sessions anytime and resume each one exactly where you left off.

Native macOS IDE for coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Goose in parallel on your own subscriptions, with a quota pool, sandboxed kill switch, per-hunk diff review and a built-in benchmark harness. Rust + gpui, Apache-2.0.

Camera management system built on Cinemachine, providing mode-based camera switching with per-mode framing profiles. Supports first-person, third-person, and custom view configurations with smooth transitions and occlusion handling. Designed to work alongside the Movement System for automatic camera adaptation per locomotion state.

Built a Java and TestNG mobile automation framework with a DriverFactory that returns an AppiumDriver for Android or iOS. The same tests run on a local phone, emulator or simulator, or on BrowserStack real devices, chosen with a single command-line switch. Moved all device, app and environment settings into a config.properties file

EcoGrow is a low-cost smart greenhouse prototype built on an Arduino Uno. A soil-moisture sensor detects dry soil and a mini pump waters the plant in short timed pulses, so water isn’t wasted. A DHT11 sensor monitors temperature and humidity, and a fan switches on automatically when it gets too hot. An LED and buzzer alert.

C program that simulates CPU scheduling with Non-Preemptive SJF and Preemptive SJF (SRTF) on a single CPU. Takes arrival and burst times, prints Gantt chart, CT, TAT, WT, RT, context switches, throughput and CPU utilization, and compares both algorithms. Includes input validation. Built for an Operating Systems course.

X-Ray for JioHotstar, on your TV. One button while watching: IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes, plot, cast, your real watch history, and one-press app switching. Prime Video already ships X-Ray; JioHotstar never got one - that is the app this is built for. Sideload, no root, no telemetry.

Website for Menan Makeovers, a bridal makeup studio in Pondicherry (menanmakeovers.com). Fully built on Wix Headless with Astro, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. The original drag-and-drop Wix Editor site is still saved in Wix, so the site can be switched back to it at any time.
